cases.name: Tempt with Bunnies
cases.text: Draw a card and create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. Then each opponent may draw a card and create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token. For each opponent who does, you draw a card and you create a 1/1 white Rabbit creature token.

cases.name: Tempt with Bunnies
